changelogversion.changelogtext: [b]New[/b] Webtoon tap-scroll now snaps to the nearest page boundary - scrolling always settles on a whole page (ComicScreen-style)
[b]Change[/b] Hidden crash-reporting and analytics toggles from the onboarding screen
[b]New[/b] Webtoon tap scroll distance: half / 3/4 / full screen
[b]New[/b] Webtoon tap scroll uses constant-speed animation, duration adjustable (0-1000ms, default 250ms)
[b]New[/b] Auto webtoon detection also checks image aspect ratio (height/width > 2.5) on the first pages
[b]New[/b] Komga tracker sync now marks only the actually read chapter (per-book PATCH), other chapters unaffected
[b]New[/b] Image enhancement: Anime4K (GPU shader, Fast/High/Ultra) and Lanczos3 (CPU, 1.5x/2x/3x), lightweight without heavy models
[b]New[/b] Original resolution option for webtoon mode (1:1 pixel display, no scaling)
[b]New[/b] Download compatibility: fall back to copy+delete when SAF rename is unsupported (卓易通/HarmonyOS, ported from zsyou/mihon-harmony)
[b]Fix[/b] Smoother tap-scroll: constant-speed linear animation, no jank
[b]Fix[/b] Auto webtoon now switches immediately even when the chapter opens with a horizontal cover
